title: Who is the enemy? The first look of Tulsa King revealed with Samuel L Jackson joining the cast - NewsBreak
text: Paramount+'s Tulsa King is a criminal drama television program starring Sylvester Stallone who plays Dwight "The General" Manfredi. As per the storyline, he is a New York mafia boss who, after serving time in jail, is transported to Tulsa, Oklahoma, to establish a new criminal organization. The show soon gained popularity after debuting in November 2022. It currently has two seasons and will shortly have a third. Actors Andrea Savage and Martin Starr are also featured on the show. The program received positive reviews and was nominated for an Emmy, and many enjoyed Stallone's performance. Additionally, a spin-off with Samuel L. Jackson has also been planned. ​ Tulsa King Season 3 introduces new foes, notably the Dunmire family, as Dwight Manfredi expands his kingdom. Additionally, Samuel L. Jackson joins the cast as Russell Lee Washington Jr., launching his own spinoff, NOLA King . The upcoming season will feature violence, treachery, and high-stakes drama in the developing criminal world. ​ ​ Tulsa King will return to Paramount+ for its third season, with fresh shocks and challenges for viewers. Sylvester Stallone returns as Dwight "The General" Manfredi, a Mafia leader who has built a strong criminal empire in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Samuel L. Jackson joins the cast this season, and there's also a new and deadly adversary. The character of Robert Patrick is going to be the season's biggest adversary: Jeremiah Dunmire. Manfredi and his family are in grave danger from Jeremiah and his son Cole Dunmire (Beau Knapp). Tulsa's underworld is contested by both factions, leading to violent clashes and one of the main themes of Season 3 is this new struggle. Samuel L. Jackson joins Tulsa King as Russell Lee Washington Jr., who will also serve as the lead of the upcoming New Orleans-based spinoff series NOLA King , which is anticipated to debut in 2025. Jackson is a well-known actor who has portrayed iconic characters in several high-profile movies. Highlights of his career include his role as Nick Fury in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and his outstanding performances in Pulp Fiction , for which he won critical acclaim. His entrance to Tulsa King universe gives the series more depth and star power. Garrett Hedlund portrays Mitch Keller, Manfredi's dependable friend and local bar owner, while Isabella Heathcote plays Cleo, a Tulsa native who reestablishes her connection with Keller in season 3. Tension is also created in Season 3 by Kevin Pollak's portrayal of Special Agent Musso, whose true loyalty is unclear. It will be unclear to viewers whether Musso supports Manfredi or opposes him. There will be a mix of action, drama, and intense power struggles this season. Viewers will remain engaged during Manfredi's conflict with the Dunmire family and other adversaries. With a spinoff series in the works and Samuel L. Jackson joining the cast, Tulsa King is growing in popularity as an exciting criminal thriller. ​ Stay tuned to Soap Central for regular updates on daily soaps, TV shows, and movies. ​
